mapper.select: SELECT TRANSACTION_ID AS transactionId, USER_ID AS userId, ACCOUNT_ID AS accountId, CARD_ID AS cardId, EXTERNAL_TRANSACTION_ID AS externalTransactionId, TRANSACTION_SOURCE AS transactionSource, CLASSIFICATION_METHOD AS classificationMethod, MERCHANT_NAME AS merchantName, MERCHANT_REGNO AS merchantRegistrationNumber, MERCHANT_CATEGORY_CODE AS merchantCategoryCode, TRANSACTION_CONTENT AS transactionContent, TRANSACTION_TYPE AS transactionType, EXPENSE_CATEGORY AS expenseCategory, TRANSACTION_AMOUNT AS transactionAmount, TRANSACTION_AT AS transactionAt, TRANSACTION_MEMO AS transactionMemo, ANALYSIS_EXCLUDED AS analysisExcluded, IS_DELETED AS isDeleted, TRANSACTION_CREATED_AT AS transactionCreatedAt, TRANSACTION_UPDATED_AT AS transactionUpdatedAt FROM `TRANSACTION` WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND IS_DELETED = false ORDER BY TRANSACTION_AT DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `TRANSACTION` (USER_ID, ACCOUNT_ID, CARD_ID, EXTERNAL_TRANSACTION_ID, TRANSACTION_SOURCE, CLASSIFICATION_METHOD, MERCHANT_NAME, MERCHANT_REGNO, MERCHANT_CATEGORY_CODE, TRANSACTION_CONTENT, TRANSACTION_TYPE, EXPENSE_CATEGORY, TRANSACTION_AMOUNT, TRANSACTION_AT, TRANSACTION_MEMO, ANALYSIS_EXCLUDED, IS_DELETED, TRANSACTION_CREATED_AT, TRANSACTION_UPDATED_AT) VALUES (#{userId}, #{accountId}, #{cardId}, #{externalTransactionId}, #{transactionSource}, #{classificationMethod}, #{merchantName}, #{merchantRegistrationNumber}, #{merchantCategoryCode}, #{transactionContent}, #{transactionType}, #{expenseCategory}, #{transactionAmount}, #{transactionAt}, #{transactionMemo}, #{analysisExcluded}, false, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT TRANSACTION_ID AS transactionId, USER_ID AS userId, ACCOUNT_ID AS accountId, CARD_ID AS cardId, EXTERNAL_TRANSACTION_ID AS externalTransactionId, TRANSACTION_SOURCE AS transactionSource, CLASSIFICATION_METHOD AS classificationMethod, MERCHANT_NAME AS merchantName, MERCHANT_REGNO AS merchantRegistrationNumber, MERCHANT_CATEGORY_CODE AS merchantCategoryCode, TRANSACTION_CONTENT AS transactionContent, TRANSACTION_TYPE AS transactionType, EXPENSE_CATEGORY AS expenseCategory, TRANSACTION_AMOUNT AS transactionAmount, TRANSACTION_AT AS transactionAt, TRANSACTION_MEMO AS transactionMemo, ANALYSIS_EXCLUDED AS analysisExcluded, IS_DELETED AS isDeleted FROM `TRANSACTION` WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND TRANSACTION_SOURCE IN ('ACCOUNT', 'CARD') AND IS_DELETED = FALSE ORDER BY TRANSACTION_AT
mapper.update: UPDATE `TRANSACTION` SET ANALYSIS_EXCLUDED = #{analysisExcluded}, TRANSACTION_UPDATED_AT = NOW() WHERE TRANSACTION_ID = #{transactionId}
mapper.select: SELECT TRANSACTION_ID AS transactionId, USER_ID AS userId, ACCOUNT_ID AS accountId, CARD_ID AS cardId, EXTERNAL_TRANSACTION_ID AS externalTransactionId, TRANSACTION_SOURCE AS transactionSource, CLASSIFICATION_METHOD AS classificationMethod, MERCHANT_NAME AS merchantName, MERCHANT_REGNO AS merchantRegistrationNumber, MERCHANT_CATEGORY_CODE AS merchantCategoryCode, TRANSACTION_CONTENT AS transactionContent, TRANSACTION_TYPE AS transactionType, EXPENSE_CATEGORY AS expenseCategory, TRANSACTION_AMOUNT AS transactionAmount, TRANSACTION_AT AS transactionAt, TRANSACTION_MEMO AS transactionMemo, ANALYSIS_EXCLUDED AS analysisExcluded, IS_DELETED AS isDeleted, TRANSACTION_CREATED_AT AS transactionCreatedAt, TRANSACTION_UPDATED_AT AS transactionUpdatedAt FROM `TRANSACTION` WHERE TRANSACTION_ID = #{transactionId} AND IS_DELETED = false

select coalesce(sum( case when TRANSACTION_TYPE = 'INCOME' and dayofweek(TRANSACTION_AT) between 2 and 6 then TRANSACTION_AMOUNT else 0 end ), 0) as weekIncomeTotal, coalesce(sum( case when TRANSACTION_TYPE in ('EXPENSE', 'FIXED') and dayofweek(TRANSACTION_AT) between 2 and 6 then TRANSACTION_AMOUNT else 0 end ), 0) as weekExpenseTotal, coalesce(sum( case when TRANSACTION_TYPE = 'INCOME' and dayofweek(TRANSACTION_AT) in (1, 7) then TRANSACTION_AMOUNT else 0 end ), 0) as weekendIncomeTotal, coalesce(sum( case when TRANSACTION_TYPE in ('EXPENSE', 'FIXED') and dayofweek(TRANSACTION_AT) in (1, 7) then TRANSACTION_AMOUNT else 0 end ), 0) as weekendExpenseTotal, coalesce(sum( case when TRANSACTION_TYPE = 'INCOME' then TRANSACTION_AMOUNT else 0 end ), 0) as monthlyIncomeTotal, coalesce(sum( case when TRANSACTION_TYPE in ('EXPENSE', 'FIXED') then TRANSACTION_AMOUNT else 0 end ), 0) as monthlyExpenseTotal from `TRANSACTION` where USER_ID = #{userId} and IS_DELETED = false and ANALYSIS_EXCLUDED = false and TRANSACTION_AT >= #{fromDateTime} and #{toDateTime} > TRANSACTION_AT
mapper.update: UPDATE TRANSACTION SET TRANSACTION_TYPE = #{transactionType}, TRANSACTION_AMOUNT = #{transactionAmount}, EXPENSE_CATEGORY = #{expenseCategory}, CLASSIFICATION_METHOD = #{classificationMethod}, ANALYSIS_EXCLUDED = #{analysisExcluded}, TRANSACTION_AT = #{transactionAt}, TRANSACTION_MEMO = #{transactionMemo}, TRANSACTION_UPDATED_AT = NOW() WHERE TRANSACTION_ID = #{transactionId}

UPDATE `TRANSACTION` SET TRANSACTION_TYPE = #{transactionType}, EXPENSE_CATEGORY = #{expenseCategory}, CLASSIFICATION_METHOD = #{classificationMethod}, ANALYSIS_EXCLUDED = #{analysisExcluded}, TRANSACTION_UPDATED_AT = NOW() WHERE TRANSACTION_ID = #{transactionId}
UPDATE `TRANSACTION` SET TRANSACTION_MEMO = #{transactionMemo}, TRANSACTION_UPDATED_AT = NOW() WHERE TRANSACTION_ID = #{transactionId}
UPDATE `TRANSACTION` SET IS_DELETED = true, TRANSACTION_UPDATED_AT = NOW() WHERE TRANSACTION_ID = #{transactionId}
mapper.select: SELECT TRANSACTION_ID AS transactionId, TRANSACTION_CONTENT AS transactionContent, EXPENSE_CATEGORY AS expenseCategory, TRANSACTION_AMOUNT AS transactionAmount, TRANSACTION_AT AS transactionAt FROM `TRANSACTION` WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND TRANSACTION_TYPE = 'FIXED' AND IS_DELETED = false ORDER BY EXPENSE_CATEGORY ASC, TRANSACTION_AT DESC
